rules.text: case identity, presence of a resumptive clitic, referential identity, the part-versus-containment judgement and the status of the first nominal are SUPPLIED evidence, never read off adjacency alone
case identity with no coordinator between the two nominals is the entry condition for the whole table; without it there is no follower relation to type

the resumptive clitic is obligatory in the two connected types and absent where the two nominals are referentially identical, but the clitic alone does not choose between the part reading and the quality reading
total apposition and appositional clarification are formally indistinguishable: where the shared label is licensed, both are returned together as the recorded outcome, not as a failure
a second nominal that predicates a property of the first is a descriptive follower and falls outside this table entirely
